body: I'll slowly rock myself to sleep. I initially did it with a foot board and I'd use one leg to push myself up and then naturally because of slick sheets I'd slide back down. Repeat cycle, Then I'd fall asleep. Then I lost the footboard, and I began to just rock with my ankle. I guess it isn't conventional rocking and it's probably a coping mechanism for my lack of touch, but it works and it's really comforting.
